description: Header file defining the ARTPSource class for handling RTP/RTCP packet processing in Android's media framework, including jitter calculation, packet queue management, and report handling.

classes.name: ARTPSource
classes.description: Class representing an RTP source, managing packet processing, jitter calculation, and RTCP reporting.

methods.name: processRTPPacket
methods.description: Processes an incoming RTP packet buffer.

methods.name: processReceptionReportBlock
methods.description: Handles reception report blocks for RTCP.

methods.name: timeUpdate
methods.description: Updates timing based on received RTP/RTCP info.

methods.name: addReceiverReport
methods.description: Adds a receiver report from RTCP.

methods.name: addTMMBR
methods.description: Adds TMMBR (Temporary Max Media Bit Rate) request.

methods.name: addNACK
methods.description: Adds a NACK (Negative Acknowledgment) for packet loss.

methods.name: getStaticJitterTimeMs
methods.description: Returns static jitter time in ms.

methods.name: setStaticJitterTimeMs
methods.description: Sets static jitter time in ms.

methods.name: isNeedToEarlyNotify
methods.description: Checks if early notification is needed.
